negative_snippets: This is the worst hotel ever. Neither the washroom is clean, nor is the service good, and the staff is also very bad. The rooms shown on MakeMyTrip, Agoda, and other apps are not even 1% like the actual rooms. Neither the room nor the washroom is clean. The washroom and room smell all the time. The shower is not working, the flush is not working, and even the TV is not working. I would say never book this hotel. They mention breakfast as a buffet, but there is no breakfast at all, and the food is completely tasteless and pathetic. This is the worst stay of my life. Even the bed is not comfortable for sleeping.”

Staffs are good. Smooth checked in. Location is nice. Room service is very good. The best thing is kitchen is open 24/7. But only thing is bothering that rooms need to be improved. And should maintain cleanliness.
